== Course of events ==

In the midst of the Queen's croquet game—where hedgehogs serve as balls and flamingoes bend their forms as mallets—the gardeners face an awful fate. Alice has already shown her mettle by refusing to bow before the Queen's magnificent procession; she has ventured even to speak with the Cheshire Cat of her discomfort with the sovereign's cruelty. Now, in this tumultuous scene, circumstances demand her quick wit and brave heart.

Alice saves the gardeners from beheading by concealing them within a flower pot, thereby outwitting the Queen's soldiers who would have carried out the sentence. It is an act of quiet defiance, a moment when intelligence and courage combine against the machinery of arbitrary violence.

Yet even this intervention cannot check the Queen's capricious will. Her arbitrary execution sentences for the smallest infractions transform the game into an exercise in chaos and terror, and her absolute authority remains unchallenged.
